recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-39012; future AssertionResponseTypes changes should be made in HL7/fhir-testing-ig.
issue_request: FHIR-39012 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core TestScript change request asking AssertionResponseTypes to support HTTP 401 Unauthorized, with the applied resolution to update the CodeSystem with valid RFC 9110 HTTP status codes while retaining responseCode for arbitrary checks.
initial_application: Git commit 51ad89525ed99bbdaf9126e198b84c637d011012 applied the issue in core by adding unauthorized/401 and the broader HTTP status-code set to source/testscript/codesystem-assert-response-code-types.xml, updating TestScript.setup.action.assert.response wording, and changing a readtest example from bad to badRequest.
additional_context: Current FHIR core no longer owns TestScript, TestReport, or TestPlan. Commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed the source/testscript tree and active fhir.ini entries, and current source/fhir.ini points testing content at the external FHIR Testing IG. The HL7/fhir-testing-ig source and CI build still include unauthorized with definition Response code is 401.
reconciliation: No core source file was changed. Reintroducing source/testscript or editing residual generated/model artifacts in FHIR core would be outside current build scope; the active artifact is maintained in HL7/fhir-testing-ig and already reflects the approved change.
